store.description: The app store that issued `bundle`. Core terms: `apple_app_store` | `google_play` | `roku_channel_store` | `amazon_appstore` | `samsung_apps_tv`. A `bundle` is unique only within its store. No OpenRTB equivalent

available.description: The line item's `audiences.available[]`, each entry projected to `id` and `name`.

delay.description: A value from List: Start Delay Modes, such as Pre-Roll (0)

slotinpod.description: A value from List: Slot Position in Pod

available.description: The line item's `break_position.available[]`, each entry projected to `id`, `delay`, and `slotinpod`.

allowed_dsps.description: The DSPs that may receive the deal (§ 5.8), each by its primary domain, as `SeatRef.dsp` (§ 2.2)

impression_multiplier.description: The line item's `delivery_counting.impression_multiplier`, projected to `impression_type` and `source_type`.

included.description: The options in the base rate, by option id.

impression_type.description: `gross` | `viewable` | `lts` | `audience`: Gross, Viewable (OTS), Likelihood-to-See, or Audience impressions, as the MRC Out-of-Home Measurement Standards (Phase 1 & 2 Combined, December 2025) define them

source_type.description: Who supplies the multiplier. A value from AdCOM 1.0 List: DOOH Multiplier Measurement Source Types other than Unknown (`0`), such as Publisher Provided (`2`). The value OpenRTB 2.6 `imp.qty.sourcetype` carries

feed.description: A value from List: Feed Types, such as Podcast (3)

instl.description: The ad is interstitial or full screen

plcmt.description: A value from List: Plcmt Subtypes - Video, such as Instream (1). Its presence states that the line item is video, so a `ctv` line item that sells video carries it

reward.description: The user receives a reward for viewing the ad

skip.description: Video or audio. The placement lets the user skip the ad

cost_method.description: The billable unit. Core terms in § 5.6.5

currency.description: The currency of the entry's rates (below)

list_rate.description: The rate before options. A buyer MAY request another value, and a granted value is the `list_rate` of the next `version`

price_type.description: How `agreed_rate` clears, as Deals API 1.0 `terms.pricetype`: Dynamic (0), the auction type of each bid request; First Price (1); Second Price Plus (2); Fixed Price (3); or an exchange-specific value, 500 and up

pricing_id.description: Names the entry within the line item. A revision MUST NOT reuse it for a different `cost_method`, `cost_parameters`, `currency`, or `transaction_mechanisms[]`

unit_bounds.description: Bounds on the units committed under this entry, counted in its unit (§ 5.6.5): `commitment.amount` when `basis` is `units`, otherwise `derived_units`. A buyer MAY request another. Absent on a `FLAT` entry

id.description: Option id (§ 3.1). It is not compared with delivered content

available.description: The line item's `programs.available[]`, each entry projected to `id` and `content`.
The line item's `properties.available[]`, each entry projected to `id`, `name`, `domains[]`, `apps[].store`, `apps[].bundle`, `child_audience`, `seller_relationship`, and `venue_type`.

apps.description: The line item's `properties.available.apps[]`, each entry projected to `store` and `bundle`.

child_audience.description: `directed` | `mixed` | `general`. `directed`: children are its primary audience under the law the seller applies, or its app store lists it for children only. `mixed`: directed to children but not as its primary audience, or listed for children and older users. `general`: neither. § 5.2.7 states what follows

domains.description: The property's domains. On a `dooh` line item, the inventory owner's domain, as OpenRTB 2.6 `dooh.domain`

venue_type.description: `taxonomy` is a value of AdCOM 1.0 List: DOOH Venue Taxonomies. `ids[]` holds exactly one id. It covers only itself, not its descendants. The values OpenRTB 2.6 `dooh.venuetypetax` and `dooh.venuetype` carry

legal_name.description: The party's legal name. A `registry_id` entry that applies can attest it; the value alone attests nothing

description: The OpenProposal `representation` module: the vocabularies, objects, unions, and constructor copies of § 2.1.
title: representation
